hypothesis: Mixture-objective contextual routing with conservative inner chronological selection avoids discarding complementary experts and improves fresh development NLL over fixed equal mixing. Cost-aware candidate selection reduces unnecessary trades under continuous-week accounting.
evaluation: 2019 only; never previously acquired by this S6/S7 campaign; not universally unseen across all research
primary: s7 vs equal, mean date NLL; practical gain 0.01 nats; both prescribed 95% interval lower endpoints must exceed 0.01
economic_primary: S7 cost-aware vs equal-expert cost-aware at 10bps; also cross every forecast with legacy signal and cost-aware policies
data: Continuous first-common-session weekly intervals, variable 3-10-day horizons, dividend cash accrued on ex-date and reinvested at interval endpoint; no daily or holiday price imputation
budget: 3 base fits, 3 seeds, one thread, two-hour maximum; explicit user RAM override retained for this directly continued research task
no_retry: No outcome-driven changes or retest of 2019; retain failures and negative outcomes
